name: socialbattery-mobile
description: SocialBattery mobile wrapper (Android + iOS via Capacitor)
author: SocialBattery

scripts.add:android: npm run check-url && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npm run gen:icons
scripts.add:ios: npm run check-url && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npm run gen:icons
scripts.sync: node scripts/apply-config.js && npx cap sync && npm run gen:icons
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:android: npm run check-url && npm run sync && node scripts/run-gradle.js assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run check-url && npm run sync && node scripts/run-gradle.js assembleDebug
